entries.proposition: Model: homozygous deletion of a Csf1r enhancer removes microglia for life while keeping circulating monocytes and perivascular macrophages; the brain develops with adaptation across the whole lifespan.
entries.snippet: These mice lack microglia throughout life, while still possessing circulating monocytes and other central nervous system (CNS)-resident (for example, perivascular) macrophages

entries.proposition: Central claim: synapse number, maturation, intrinsic properties and LGN segregation were largely normal in CA1, somatosensory cortex and LGN.
entries.snippet: Thus, microglia are not essential for several aspects of hippocampal CA1 synaptic and cellular development for which they have been proposed to have a role.

entries.proposition: PTZ seizure latency and duration did not differ between genotypes (n = 9 and 11 mice).
entries.snippet: We detected no difference in seizure latency and duration in Csf1r∆FIRE/∆FIRE versus Csf1r+/+ mice when PTZ seizures were elicited under the same conditions (Fig. 8a).

entries.proposition: A difference was found in NMDAR decay time at P14 in layer 4 cortex (P = 0.016) that disappeared by P42; the authors call it precociously low.
entries.snippet: Interestingly, the weighted time constant of NMDAR-mediated EPSCs, which reflects the subunit composition of NMDARs, was slightly lower in Csf1r∆FIRE/∆FIRE neurons at P14 than WT, although this difference was no longer apparent at P42 (Fig. 4m).

entries.proposition: The authors report a small rise in astrocytic GFAP at P14 and in reactive markers at P42, suggesting reactivity increases with age.
entries.snippet: we observed a small increase in GFAP expression at P14 (Fig. 7e and Extended Data Fig. 8); by P42 our bulk RNA-seq data also showed an increase in reactive markers, including Gfap, Vim and Serpina3n

entries.proposition: The authors state that not every developmental process is microglia-independent: a cortical boundary cavity persists to P7 in these mice.
entries.snippet: some aspects of brain development have an absolute requirement for microglia

entries.proposition: The authors say a different group found raised rheobase and reduced NMDAR charge transfer in the same mouse in hippocampus; the discrepancy is unresolved.
entries.snippet: Further studies are needed to rationalize these conflicting results.

entries.proposition: Mechanism space: the conclusion is stated as adaptability and that astrocytes may compensate; it does not say microglia are dispensable in disease.
entries.snippet: it is possible that in the context of control of synapse numbers and patterning, that astrocytes carry out functions that ordinarily are carried out by microglia.

entries.proposition: Lifespan: the study spans P4 to P42 for synapse and electrophysiology and weeks for LFP; no myelin, white-matter or gliosis-in-injury endpoint is reported.
entries.snippet: Csf1r∆FIRE/∆FIRE mice have normal body and brain weight23, avoiding confounders of other microglia-deficient models

entries.proposition: Pharmacological microglial ablation is called problematic by the authors: the CSF1R antagonist PLX5622 has effects beyond microglia.
entries.snippet: the CSF1R antagonist PLX5622 has effects on nonmicroglial cells, including circulating macrophages, T and B lymphocytes, and hematopoietic progenitors

entries.proposition: The statistical frame is nested t-tests on cells within animals; P = 0.062 for barrel-field rostro-caudal position and 0.081 for sEPSC amplitude are reported as not different.
entries.snippet: c, Caudal and rostral relative position of the barrel field (t(16) = 2.01, P = 0.062, Student’s two-tailed t-test), n = 10 Csf1r+/+ and n = 8 Csf1rΔFIRE/ΔFIRE mice.
